tei:div.tei:p: gnam chos gtor bzlog 'don 'grigs bzhugs/ ༄༅/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ gter kha 'di yi 'jigs byed gyi gtor bzlog chen mo spyan ras gzigs chags med rin po che'i yig cha dang*/ drag po phur 'jug can gyi gtor bzlog sngar kho bos byas pa dag ni 'di la ltos mi dgos mod/ gzhan dag 'di la 'dzud par 'dod pas ston par spro na/ rgyas pa dang*/ 'bring po dang*/ bsdus pa gsum/ dang po la/ hrīḥsngon bskal ma= tshul khrims dri ldan= gsol 'debs spro na gzi byin kun 'dus/ mtshan brgyad gsol 'debs rnams dang*/ skyabs sems bdun/ rnam dag sngon gtor/ rtsa gsum las byang la lha bskyed gang 'dod sbyar/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bzlas pa rnams ci mang bzlas mthar srung 'khor dmigs bzlas mthar srung 'khor dmigs 198) bzlas thal rdeb bcas/ mthun rdzas sgrub/ mchod bstod dge bsngo bcas bya/ de nas lus dkyil yongs rdzogs/ ma ning nas klu rgyal yan gsol kha 'grub rjes/ chags med rin po che'i yig cha ltar rno bkra'i tshogs byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren/ 'bul ba/ gtor bsngos bdud rtsi kun khyab/ bskang thung*/ spro na chags med bskang chen gyi bskang rdzas byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren/ phyag 'tshal/ mnga' gsol/ skong dmigs rjes/ rdzogs chen don bskang*/ rig 'dzin rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rjes/ chags med yig cha rtsa tshig 'dres shas che ba chos skyong rgya mtsho zin nas/ chos skyong bskang ba ci rigs/ spro na chags med pa'i gsol spungs/ bka' srung*/ nor lha rgya mtsho'i rjes/ dzam la sogs nor lha'i skong ba/ phyi rgyud rgya mtsho/ rdzas bskang bshags pa cha tshang brdebs 'don rjes/ 'di'i gzhung bskul dang*/ chags med rin po che'i thun gtor 199) dbu nas/ dngos grub zhu= rjes su/ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das= sbrel ba/ dhe ru'i spyi bskul/ gser skyems rjes/ sku gsum brgyud gsum=

dkar gtor cha gsum dkar dmar bcas tshang ba/ gzu dpang rjes gzu dpang dkar nag shan 'byed/ dam brdar drag po'i btsan dug brub bskyed/ 'gugs pa gsum/ bden chung dgu/ rtsa rgyud= gsum/ pho nya spro ba/ lha dbye/ thun brab/ phur gdab/ gris gtub/ tho brdung*/ zhal bstab bcas/ tshogs drang ba lhag ma rnams rno bkra ltar/ bstod 'bum/ bzlog bskul/ chos sku zhi ba'i= mjug tu bskang chen ltar/ rig 'dzin bzlog pa/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bzlog pa/ khro rgyal rgya mtsho'i bzlog pa'i rjes/ drag po'i dgra chos/ king kang dgra chos rnams dang*/ mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong*/ nor lha/ phyi rgyud bzlog pa rnams kyi rjes su/ spro na chags med pa'i bzlog spungs/ g.yu sgron bskul pa/ 200) btsan mgon dgra bzlog rnams dpe ci 'dzom dang*/ dgra chos ma g.yel ma/ yi dam lha tshogs= rnams btang rjes/ mdos zor sha khrag= grangs gsog rjes/ wa bzlog 'ug zlog rnams sbyar/ zlog sngags bsag thun gtor mthar/ bhyo gdab bcas bya/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud= rno bkra'i chad brtan/ gzhung gi rta bro/ rjes chog mchod bstod rjes/ rno bkra ltar bshags pa/ rten bzhugs yan gzhung ltar/ 'phang nyin/ bzlog pa'i mthar/ zor rdzas sgrub/ thun gtor 'bul/ sgo dbye rjes/ gtor snod bhandha= rtsa rgyud= gzhung bskul thun gtor/ spyi bskul/ dgra chos sogs ci 'grub rjes phyi sgo gser skyems/ dkar gtor/ me thog ra dge khra tsha/ glud rdzongs sogs dang*/ nang du rno bkra ltar chad tho btang*/ 'phang sar phyin nas/ dkar gtor/ srid ho'i rgyab yig za lam/ 'jigs byed gser 201) skyems/ ind+ra ya na= bstan dgra tshar gcod= e khang bskyed pa/ 'gugs pa/ bden chung*/ rtsa rgyud= rang gi thugs ka= sogs nas/ thum ya rbad: phur thun mtshams/ dgra yi sha khrag brlag byed gyur: gzhung gi zor bskul dang zor rnams 'phang*/ gtor chen 'phang tshig rjes/ dpal khrag 'thung khro bo'i rgyal po khyod bdag la gson=

mdos zer= ye shes lha tshogs khyed la= 'phan sar āḥ bar brtan ma/ bro mnan/ phyi lam bcad/ nang du log la/ rgyal dbyangs mngon spyod lam byed/ dus gsum bde gshegs= 'gugs pa tshe brtan ma/ gzhung ltar dngos grub blang*/ lha spyi'i sgrub mchod ltar mchod bstod bshags gsum/ rten bzhugs man gzhung ltar byas pas grub bo// gnyis pa lag len 'bring po'i dbang du btang na/ 'di nyid kyi gzhung rang nas gsal ba ltar/ bskyed bzlas stong tshig yan grub 202) rjes/ kho bos byas pa'i rtsa gsum dam can spyi'i gtor ma'i cho ga shin tu rgyas pa ltar mchod pa byin rlabs/ rtsa gsum spyi gtor/ lha bskyed/ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol/ dam bzhag phyi nang gsang mchod/ sman rag gtor mchod/ sngags 'bul yongs rdzogs/ 'dod gsol bstod ring ma bcas sger gsol/ ma ning dang*/ gnod sbyin/ gter gzhi gnyis/ bzlas pa/ mchod bstod bcas grub mtshams/ gzhung ltar tshogs bskang rjes/ bskang gso'i bskang rdzas byin rlabs/ spyir bskang ba/ bye brag bskang ba/ bshags pa/ phrin bcol bcas/ gzhung gi bskul pa/ bsad las/ bzlog pa/ thun gtor rjes/ bskang gso'i gtor 'gugs nas/ bkra shis yan/ chad brtan man gzhung ltar/ grol nyin gzhung gsal ltar/ dngos grub len chog rjes/ gsol ka bka' brgyad/ mchod bstod man gzhung ltar ro/ gsum pa bsdus pa ni/ 203) gzhung gsal ji lta ba la/ gtor chog sngags 'bul bsdus pa'i lugs sbyar bas grub bo// bzlog gtor gur drag gsang sgrub la 'khor bcu drug pa/ gzhan rnams la gtor chung mtheb skyu grangs med kyis bskor bar bya/ mchog gi las sgrub pa la lhag pa'i lha gang la brten kyang rung mod/ thun mong phran tshegs la mtshon na/ bstan 'gro spyi'i rim gro la/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad/ rgyal 'gong zhi ba la gur drag skor/ byad phur bzlog pa la gshin rje dmar nag 'jigs gsum/ khro king 'char gsum dang*/ gdugs dkar rnams dang khyad par tshe bdag zab/

sngags pa nang gyes bzlog pa la lo kt+ra zab/ mu stegs pa'i byad kha bzlog pa la seng gdong zab/ sa bdag klu yi gnod pa bzlog pa la nā ga raksha khyung dmar skor zab/ btsan gnod bzlog pa la rta mgrin dmar nag gza' yi gnyen po phyag rdor rnams dang*/ 204) spyi dgos 'gal rkyen bzlog pa la phur pa/ ma mo 'khrugs pa sogs nad rim bzlog pa la khros ma dang lo gyon rnams zab/ dgra bzlog la khro bo king kang rigs rnams dang*/ rkun bu bzlog pa la 'od zer can/ grib bzlog la rnams 'joms dme brtsegs rigs dang*/ chos skyong gi bka' chad bzlog pa la khro chu sogs dgos pas mtshon skabs shes par bya'o// zhes pa'ang padma ma ṇis so// dge'o//
